cmd/agent-worker/main.go and cmd/agentdoc/main.go: authenticated companion-repository cloning and a new documentation-generation tool are unrelated to adopting a moved PR head during resume. The cloning changes worker network behavior and exposes additional repositories to agent sessions. Split these features and the unrelated console work out of this targeted workflow fix.

internal/console/actions.go (chatFiling): a closed intake previously rejected a wake's filings; it now rejects only calls carrying roadmapItem. A wake can therefore file new_card or request_image with the item omitted while intake remains closed, as the changed tests explicitly permit. This weakens an existing operator admission control without authorization from the task.

internal/console/chat.go (run): cancellation is checked after the entire answer.ToolCalls batch, while tool calls use the uncancelled request context. If Stop is pressed during the first of several calls, remaining not-yet-started writes still execute. Check cancellation at each tool boundary and persist completed results without starting the rest.

internal/console/answer.go (chatAskPress): choosing a non-bound answer starts t.run directly, but the stop context and stopGate entry are established by chatPost rather than t.run. This streamed model turn consequently ignores the stop endpoint despite appearing as a running turn. Establish cancellation registration for this path too, preferably centrally for model turns.

internal/console/chat.go (run): a LiveAskBinds error is only logged, leaving parked empty and allowing execution to continue. During a binding-store failure, an otherwise automatically applied write can execute through the model instead of waiting for the bound human press. Refuse the turn or writes until binding state can be read rather than failing open.

internal/console/chat_reads.go (fileText): range reads count only len(line), excluding newlines and rendered line-number prefixes. Empty lines never advance the size counter, so from=1 can return hundreds of thousands of numbered lines despite the advertised 64 KiB cap, flooding the model context. Enforce the cap on the complete rendered output.

[P1] internal/factoryd/runner.go: readable now expands session read tokens to sandbox companion repositories, and workerPodSpec clones them. Together with the new companion merge gates, roadmap deduplication, and chat/metrics/agentdoc features, this substantially exceeds the moved-head resume objective. In particular, the additional repository access is an unrequested permission/network change and should be separated from this fix.

[P2] internal/factoryd/console_store.go: ChainFacts scans h.dismissed_at into sql.NullBool, although it is a dismissal timestamp, and leaves f.Dismissed false. When the head has a dismissal timestamp, scanning fails and breaks chain readouts for its carried cards. Scan into sql.NullTime and populate Dismissed from its validity.

[P2] internal/factoryd/chainpoll.go: companions permanently marks a card in p.woken as soon as Temporal accepts its signal. If the workflow's subsequent live companion read fails transiently or observes a changed branch, it holds again, but every later poll skips that card—even after the companion becomes readable and meets the pin. Track the hold generation or permit another wake after a failed recheck instead of suppressing signals for the process lifetime.

internal/factoryd/wakes.go: passProject now invokes fireRefill, which can start queue_refill agent turns that file cards, perform roadmap-head reads, and persist pull stamps. Together with RefillBelow in internal/policy/project.go, this introduces independent autonomous intake behavior unrelated to resuming a moved head. Split it out of this fix.

internal/factoryd/workflow.go and internal/factoryd/workflow_stages.go: the companions version, GateCompanion activity, and companion_landed recheck path add a new merge dependency mechanism. The added test explicitly changes an otherwise automatic merge into a held approval. That is a separate gating feature, not required for resume-head adoption, and should not ship in this bugfix.

internal/schema/migrations/factoryd/20261110000000_ask_bound_action.sql and internal/schema/migrations/factoryd/20261110110000_chat_cut.sql introduce bound chat actions and stopped-answer persistence. These production schema changes support unrelated chat features; the resume-hold change requires neither. Remove or split them rather than coupling their deployment to this workflow fix.
